headline: Put it on
your list.
features.sub: Press the list icon on a product card. The card then says On list.

headline: Grouped by
shop.
features.sub: Products sit under the shop with the best buy. Skip a shop, and they move.

headline: Tick it off.
features.sub: Cross items off as you shop. They move to the bottom of the list.

where: List icon in the header › Open shopping list
